description.narrative: .At the 87th meeting of the Executive Committee, in June 2021, the guidelines for the preparation of Kigali HFC implementation plans (KIPs) for Article 5 countries have been approved. Subsequently the request for funding for the preparation of the KIP for Mexico, at a cost of US $230,000, to be implemented with assistance provided by UNIDO (US $115,000), UNDP (US $85,000) and UNEP (US $30,000).
